ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lateral lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle region and trailing margins).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central V-shaped region extending from base to mid-fluke. Lateral lobes are predominantly white. Distinct dark circular mottling at [x=0.15, y=0.30] on the left lobe and [x=0.88, y=0.25] on the right lobe. High-density pixel speckling at the transition zone between black and white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 18 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 14% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing margin. Edge displays sharp triangular peaks (amplitude 5-15 pixels) interspersed with deep irregular valleys, particularly dense toward the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trajectory follows a multi-segmented jagged concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by significant pixel-level variance due to serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast circular pixel groupings (barnacles) located on the distal tips of both lobes. Multiple dark, roughly circular 'rosette' scars (diameter ~3% of lobe width) present on the interior white surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark vertical linear mark on the lower interior of the left lobe. Several faint diagonal linear disruptions on the lower right lobe near the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on lateral tips; irregular deep-notching along the trailing edge suggesting historical mechanical trauma or environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation distribution where the central black region exhibits greater lateral extension into the right lobe relative to the left lobe.
